cands.name: Michael K. Garrett
cands.bio: Democrat who has served in the North Carolina Senate for District 27 (Guilford County) since January 2019, after defeating incumbent Trudy Wade in 2018. Born in Raleigh, UNC Greensboro graduate (2007), and managing partner of a family-owned marketing firm.

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina is listed as endorsing Garrett in the 2026 election.

cands.gaps: The sources do not show Garrett's positions or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, growth and land conservation, H-1B or immigration enforcement, policing, gun laws, abortion, or school vouchers and charters. The sponsored-legislation table on his Ballotpedia page had no entries, so no bills he sponsored could be identified. Ballotpedia notes he did not complete its 2024 or 2026 candidate surveys. His only stated positions come from the 2020 survey, which covers school construction, teacher pay, Medicaid expansion and an independent redistricting commission. No news reporting on controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements beyond the Sierra Club was available. His private-sector background is described only as managing partner of a family marketing firm, with no further detail.

local.label: Roots 100: Ballotpedia lists his birthplace as Raleigh, NC, and in his 2020 candidate survey he calls himself a 'born and bred North Carolinian' who attended Guilford County Schools and UNC Greensboro and lives in Greensboro.

This addresses teacher pay only. He did not state a position on vouchers, charters or school choice, and gave no specific raise figure.
